about.headline: Born from a belief that self-awareness should be accessible, evidence-based, and deeply transformative.
about.p1: Awareness Be was founded in 2026 on a simple premise: the modern wellness industry has lost its way. Too much noise, too little evidence, too many quick fixes and not enough depth.
about.p2: We exist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge neuroscience and ancient wisdom — between embodied cognition and mindful living, between personalized data and intuitive practice.
about.p3: Every article we publish, every session we offer, every practice we recommend passes through the same filter: is this evidence-backed? Is this aligned with holistic growth? Would this serve someone we love?
about.quote: "We don't sell miracles. We cultivate clarity, restore balance, and provide the tools for evidence-based transformation that lasts."

INTJ.title: Strategic Architect
INTJ.desc: You are a strategic thinker who sees the big picture. Independent and analytical, you excel at developing long-term plans and enjoy intellectual challenges.

INTP.title: Logical Architect
INTP.desc: You are a curious and analytical mind. Driven by logic and creativity, you love exploring complex ideas and finding innovative solutions.

ENTJ.title: Commander
ENTJ.desc: You are a natural leader with strong organizational abilities. Bold and confident, you excel at taking charge and driving projects forward.

ENTP.title: Debater
ENTP.desc: You are an innovative thinker who loves intellectual debate. Creative and curious, you enjoy exploring new ideas and possibilities.

INFJ.title: Advocate
INFJ.desc: You are an insightful idealist with a deep sense of compassion. Creative and dedicated, you strive to help others and make a meaningful impact.

INFP.title: Mediator
INFP.desc: You are a thoughtful idealist guided by your values. Creative and empathetic, you seek to understand others and find authentic expression.

ENFJ.title: Protagonist
ENFJ.desc: You are an inspiring leader with natural charisma. Passionate and idealistic, you motivate others to become their best selves.

ENFP.title: Campaigner
ENFP.desc: You are an enthusiastic and creative spirit. Curious and optimistic, you see possibilities everywhere and inspire others with your energy.

ISTJ.title: Logistician
ISTJ.desc: You are a responsible and practical realist. Dependable and organized, you value honesty and take your commitments seriously.

ISFJ.title: Defender
ISFJ.desc: You are a loyal and supportive protector. Warm and caring, you are dedicated to helping others and maintaining harmony.

ESTJ.title: Executive
ESTJ.desc: You are a practical and organized leader. Strong-willed and dependable, you excel at managing projects and people.

ESFJ.title: Consul
ESFJ.desc: You are a warm and social organizer. Caring and supportive, you enjoy helping others and creating harmonious environments.

ISTP.title: Virtuoso
ISTP.desc: You are a practical problem-solver who loves hands-on work. Analytical and adaptable, you enjoy understanding how things work.

ISFP.title: Adventurer
ISFP.desc: You are a sensitive and artistic explorer. Gentle and flexible, you appreciate beauty and enjoy new experiences.

ESTP.title: Entrepreneur
ESTP.desc: You are an energetic and practical achiever. Bold and adaptable, you thrive in dynamic situations and love taking action.

ESFP.title: Entertainer
ESFP.desc: You are a spontaneous and enthusiastic performer. Fun-loving and outgoing, you live in the moment and love entertaining others.
